name: week
title: This week at school
subtitle: School Admin for Claude Code: what needs a person this week

sections.title: Compliance
sections.note: Checked against the rules in docs/compliance.md. Breaches first.
sections.sql: select severity, rule, code, who, finding from compliance_checks order by array_position(array['breach','due','check']::text[], severity), rule, code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Fees, attendance, enrolments, care and consent in one list.
sections.sql: select area, code, who, issue from attention order by array_position(array['staff checks','care','attendance','consent','fees','enrolments']::text[], area), code

name: debtors
title: Debtors
subtitle: Family balances, aged by the oldest unpaid term

sections.title: Overdue accounts
sections.sql: select code, name, balance_cents, overdue_1_30_cents, overdue_31_60_cents, overdue_61_90_cents, overdue_90_plus_cents, oldest_days_overdue, on_payment_plan, currency from debtors order by oldest_days_overdue desc

sections.title: Active payment plans
sections.sql: select pp.code, f.name as family, pp.instalment_cents, pp.frequency, pp.starts_on, (select currency from setting_values) as currency from payment_plans pp join families f on f.id = pp.family_id where pp.status = 'active'

name: enrolments
title: Enrolments
subtitle: Next year's places and the enquiries behind them

sections.title: Places by year group
sections.sql: select entry_year, year_level, places, confirmed, offers_out, in_pipeline, siblings_waiting, places_left from waitlist order by entry_year, year_level

sections.title: Enquiries needing a next step
sections.sql: select code, child_name, entry_year, entry_level, stage, issue from enquiry_pipeline where issue is not null order by entry_year, entry_level
